feedforward.tabRound2: Round 2 · What I take away and decide
feedforward.round1Title: ROUND 1 – What my colleagues see in me and for me
feedforward.round2Title: ROUND 2 – What I take away and what I decide
feedforward.round2Intro: After listening to their colleagues' contributions, the beneficiary speaks again. They do not answer each perception point by point. They choose what to keep for their development and turn it into concrete decisions.
feedforward.pickColleague: Choose the colleague you are addressing.

human_qualities.title: 1. What I appreciate in you as a person
human_qualities.question: The 2 or 3 human qualities I recognise in you and sincerely appreciate?
human_qualities.hint: If possible, illustrate at least one quality with an example or a concrete situation.

professional_contribution.title: 2. What I appreciate in your professional contribution
professional_contribution.question: The professional qualities, technical skills or ways of working that are, in my view, your main strengths?
professional_contribution.hint: I may think of: expertise, reliability, analytical ability, team spirit, results orientation, decision-making, leadership, client relations, ability to mobilise others.

achievements.title: 3. Your great achievements at {{company}} that we recognise and value
achievements.question: The results, achievements or contributions you have delivered and that we are particularly proud of over the last 2 years or since you joined {{company}}? The positive impact they have had for {{company}}, your team, clients or your colleagues?
achievements.hint: Name 1 to 3 achievements and state their real impact for {{company}}, or the teams, or clients or partners.

impact.title: 4. What could further increase your impact
impact.question: If I were to give you a few suggestions to help you become even more effective and influential, I would suggest you strengthen, adjust or experiment with?
impact.hint: I favour 1 or 2 truly important recommendations, worded as levers for the future and not as a judgement.

impact_leadership.title: 4.1 – Leadership, attitudes and behaviours
impact_leadership.question: Which behaviours could you develop further, adjust or experiment with to strengthen your impact in your relationships and leadership?

impact_skills.title: 4.2 – Skills and professional practices
impact_skills.question: Which skills, methods or ways of working could you strengthen further to be more efficient and effective?

potential.title: 5. The potential I see in you
potential.question: If you keep building on your strengths and developing your priorities for progress, what additional contribution do I see you making in the next 3 to 5 years?
potential.hint: Which role, level of responsibility or type of contribution could, in my view, let you have even more impact?

commitmentBlock.title: 6. My personal commitment by your side
commitmentBlock.question: To help you succeed and grow professionally within {{company}}, what do I personally commit to?
commitmentBlock.hint: My commitment must be concrete, realistic and observable: availability, information sharing, feedback, support, collaboration, introductions, delegation, etc.

commitment_how.title: How you can count on me

touched.title: 1. What particularly touched or positively surprised me
touched.question: What did I hear that made me aware of a strength, a quality or a contribution I did not fully measure?

strengths.title: 2. The strengths I want to build on more
strengths.question: Which strengths will I deliberately use more in my role and in my contribution to the {{company}} team?

priorities.title: 3. My 1 to 2 development priorities
priorities.question: Among the suggestions received, which areas do I personally choose to work on first?

commitment_90_days.title: 4. My 90-day commitment
commitment_90_days.question: Which concrete and observable change will I implement in the next 90 days?

support.title: 5. The support I expect from my colleagues
support.question: What kind of support, feedback, cooperation or reminder do I need to succeed in this commitment?

feedforward.viewHint: What your colleagues see in you, what they commit to by your side, and what you decide to do with it. Contributions are signed.

report.title: Evaluation report — 360° Feedforward
report.intro: Choose the report to produce for the “{{campaign}}” campaign. The PDF file downloads as soon as it is ready.
report.globalHint: Organisation summary: participation, recognised strengths, impact levers, potential, commitments, Round 2, recommendations and appendices.
report.individualHint: What a person's colleagues see in them and for them, their commitments, and the next steps towards Round 2.
report.pickPerson: Choose the person whose individual report you want.
